subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
5. 
Mr. A was preparing the documents and audit file in physical (paper) 
form, believing that it is compulsory to do so. Is Mr. A's understanding, 
correct? Identify the correct statement regarding the form of an audit 
file. 
(a) 
Audit file should be kept in both physical & electronic form. 
(b) 
Audit file should be kept in physical form only. 
(c) 
Audit file may be kept in physical or electronic form. 
(d) 
Audit file should be kept in electronic form only. 
General MCQs
